_about: TODAY's country of a ribbon card's place, where the kit's table cannot name it and this archive's own evidence settles it (the --countries file of the kit's ribbonflags.py; kit/docs/ribbon-flags.md). Key: the place exactly as the card prints it (a spouse line without its leading 'of '). Value: an ISO code, or null for a line that names no country (looked at, and left without a flag). Typed by hand; tools/ribbonflags.py reads it. Each entry's evidence is in _evidence.

_evidence.the Cape, place not known: The Cape of the Dutch East India Company: the archive's earliest man is known only from the 1876 Rustenburg death notice of his son, who was born at Graaff-Reinet about 1788 (people.js, story.json chapter 1). The Cape of that century lies wholly in South Africa today.
_evidence.the Cape: George Downing Mountjoy Booyzen: born 1 June 1901, Cape Province (people.js); the Cape Province is South Africa's (the kit's own table names 'cape province' ZA).
_evidence.district Rustenburg: Rustenburg, Transvaal (places.json: 'Where the male line's oldest documented man died'), North West Province, South Africa. A district, so it is given no era region (its bounds cannot be tested against a ring).
_evidence.district Graaff-Reinet: Graaff-Reinet, Cape Colony (places.json, era-ground.tsv: inside the cape ring), Eastern Cape, South Africa.
_evidence.Zevenfontein: The family farm at Brak River, later Middelburg district, Cape (places.json 'Zevenfontein': two death notices, 1863 and 1884), South Africa.
_evidence.Zevenfontein, Brak River: The same farm (places.json 'Zevenfontein', region 'Brak River, later Middelburg district'); the 1863 death notice of Johanna Catharina Mountjoy, KAB MOOC 6/9/104 (sources.json).
_evidence.achter Sneeuwberg: 'Behind the Sneeuberg', the place column of the 1851 Graaff-Reinet baptism register: the Karoo north of Graaff-Reinet (places.json 'Achter Sneeuwberg'), South Africa.
_evidence.Indwe: A colliery town of the north-eastern Cape (places.json 'Indwe'; era-ground.tsv 'a Cape Colony town'), Eastern Cape, South Africa.
_evidence.baptised at Graaff-Reinet and Dordrecht,: LEFT WITHOUT A FLAG, deliberately. Both towns are the Cape's (Graaff-Reinet and Dordrecht are rows of era-ground.tsv, region cape; Dordrecht is the Cape town at -31.372, 27.041 in places.json, not the Dutch city), so the country is South Africa; but a flag's words quote the line, and this line's own words carry a year (1859), which a today flag may not (the kit's checkribbonflags R5: a today flag with a year). The card's other lines keep their flags.
_evidence.Barkly East: Barkly East (Barkly Oost), town and district of the north-eastern Cape (places.json), Eastern Cape, South Africa.
_evidence.de Bruins Poort: 'a man who died at de Bruins Poort in the Cape' in 1853 (kin.js, the John Barry household; people.js 'John Barry'), the Cape Colony of 1853, South Africa today.
_evidence.“Wurtemburg”, Colesberg: The farm 'Wurtemburg' in the Colesberg district where George Augustus Kolbe died on 1 December 1844 (people.js; places.json 'Colesberg', Northern Cape midlands; KAB MOOC 6/9/35: 7698). Colesberg is in South Africa. Not Württemberg: the quoted word is the farm's name.
_evidence.Manorowen, Barkly East: The Barrys' farm Manorowen in the Barkly East district (places.json 'Barkly East'; the 1915 death notice signed at Manorowen), South Africa. Not the Pembrokeshire village of the same name (barry.astro says so): the card names Barkly East.
_evidence.Burgersdorp: Burgersdorp, where Margaret Downing's death notice was filed on 30 January 1868 (people.js; places.json 'Burgersdorp', the Kolbe-Downing monument), Eastern Cape, South Africa.
_evidence.Stutterheim: Stutterheim, Eastern Cape (places.json 'Stutterheim', region Eastern Cape), South Africa.
_evidence.district Cradock: Cradock, Cape Colony (places.json; era-ground.tsv: inside the cape ring), Eastern Cape, South Africa. A district, so no era region.
_evidence.Potchefstroom district: Potchefstroom, Transvaal (places.json 'Potchefstroom', region Transvaal), North West Province, South Africa. A district, so no era region.
_evidence.“Europe”: The word of James Montjoy's record, in quotation marks: a continent, not a country. No flag.
_evidence.“at sea, British”: Born at sea, as his record says: no country's ground. No flag.
_evidence.an Argentine-descended family: A description of the spouse's family, not a place. No flag.
